Test that an explicit load() to a media element whose preload is set to "none" still loads the video.

EXPECTED (video.preload == 'none') OK
EXPECTED (video.readyState == '0') OK
EXPECTED (video.readyState == '0') OK
RUN(video.load())
EVENT(loadedmetadata)
END OF TEST
